io.tesseraql:tesseraql-s3 0.14.0 发布, Optional S3 (and S3-compatible) object store for attachments (roadmap Phase 30
    slice 2): an S3BlobStore on AWS SDK for Java v2 (Apache-2.0), selected by
    tesseraql.object-storage.provider: s3 and discovered through the BlobStoreProvider ServiceLoader
    (the PdfEngine idiom). One module covers AWS S3 and every compatible store (Cloudflare R2, Ceph,
    Backblaze B2) via endpoint/region/pathStyle/checksumMode. Apps that do not store blobs in S3
    simply omit this jar, so the AWS SDK stays out of their deployment. Integration tests run against
    Adobe S3Mock (Apache-2.0); MinIO is not used (its server is AGPLv3, ch. 50 decision point 6).

io.tesseraql:tesseraql-pdf 0.14.0 发布, Optional printable-documents (pdf) codec for query-export/file-export (roadmap
    Phase 21): Thymeleaf-rendered HTML templates with page-oriented CSS and embedded CJK
    fonts, deterministic output, rendered through openhtmltopdf (the engine adopted at the
    ch. 50 license decision, replaceable behind the module's PdfEngine SPI). Apps that never
    print PDFs simply do not install this jar, so its LGPL dependency stays out of their
    deployment; putting it on the classpath is the whole install (ServiceLoader, design
    ch. 28, 47).

        (system properties over environment over properties file), model builders serializing
        to the API contract, an HTTP client with token auth, retries and timeouts,
        run-selection modes, and an Allure-compatible file sink. No runtime dependencies:
        HTTP via java.net.http (JDK 11+), JSON via a small built-in codec, so any
        test-framework adapter can build on top of it.

        client-Java engine — synchronizer, compiler, ClassConsumer SPI, controller routing) and
        components/engine/engine-bpm-flowable (only needs to resolve client-compiled classes from
        delegate expressions). Extracted from engine-java's runtime package so engine-bpm-flowable
        can depend on this small leaf module instead of the full engine — that in turn lets
        components/api/api-modules-java publish the org.eclipse.dirigible.sdk.* annotations to
        engine-java without forming a cycle through api-bpm.

        Liquibase JSON changelogs in src/main/resources/db/changelog/ create and version every
        platform table; Hibernate is reduced to schema validation (DIRIGIBLE_DATABASE_SYSTEM_DDL_AUTO
        defaults to "validate") and no longer issues DDL during application startup.
        Dynamic user entities (TypeScript @Entity via data-store, Java @Entity via
        data-store-java) continue to use Hibernate's hbm2ddl=update because their schema is
        authored by end-user code, not by changelogs.
